items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I would say in comparison would be with Stan Kenton and the way Capital believed in him... I was convinced more by Stan Kenton wanting to convince me to do it than by anyone else.

ctx.x: Just as -- I would say in comparison would be with Stan Kenton and the way Capital believed in him and worked and allowed him his head, with him (unintelligible).
Okay. Didn't you tell me some anecdotal things about how the band was playing flying somewhere, and they were rehearsing and they I'd have had to come back downstairs --
